positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationState
positions.frame: What is the calibration state of the Kestrelwood spectrograph, at what frequency, and against what reference is it verified?
positions.why: All three expressions read in one direction: a flat, unhedged present-state claim that the instrument is calibrated at a named frequency, with the verification against June reference plates cited as settled past fact. src-1 carries the assertion in prose ('is now calibrated at 88.4 MHz', 'holds across the full observing band'); src-2 and src-3 restate the same content in labeled memo form (instrument named, calibration value and reference given). The register is realis and concrete throughout, and the authority rests on demonstrated verification work rather than rank. No tension across the set — the memo fields and the prose assertion say the same thing in different shapes.
